title: Swastikas spray-painted on former Nazi transit camp in Paris suburbs
summary: Swastikas have been spray-painted on two buildings in Drancy, the suburb that once housed France’s principal wartime internment camp for Jews deported to Auschwitz-Birkenau. The graffiti, discovered by a municipal election candidate, has sparked condemnation and a formal complaint, highlighting enduring anti-Semitic tensions in in a country home to Europe’s…
